name: Chang'e 3
intro: Ni hao! I'm Yutu, the Jade Rabbit, named after the rabbit that lives on the Moon in Chinese legend.
First soft landing anywhere on the Moon in 37 years!
The plan said Sinus Iridum, the Bay of Rainbows, but the team picked a spot in Mare Imbrium instead.
My lander uses cameras to dodge rocks, so we need daylight.
briefing: We are hovering 100 metres up, scanning for a flat spot.
fact: The Chang'e 3 lander kept working for years: one of the longest-lived landers on the Moon.
